specialty_focus: HSI Emergency Care is a training and compliance organization providing emergency response training programs, compliance tools, and physical safety products for workplaces, schools, and professional instructors. It specializes in CPR, AED, First Aid, Advanced Life Support, Trauma & Crisis Mitigation, and Workplace Compliance with OSHA standards. It does not appear to be a wearable medical device manufacturer or distributor.
